The morning mist had barely lifted from the sect's grand tournament arena when Li Qiye arrived. His expression was calm, but those who knew him could see the faint gleam of anticipation in his eyes. Today was not an ordinary day.

The readings were impossible. Li Qiye stared at the screen, his breath catching. If the data was correct, everything they thought they knew about the prophecy was wrong.

His aura exploded outward as he stepped into the next realm. The implications were staggering. He had to tell someone — but who could he trust?

A sound from the corridor made him freeze. Someone was coming. Li Qiye quickly closed the terminal and slipped into the shadows. The door slid open, and a figure stepped inside.

It was Lin Feng. They locked eyes, and in that moment, Li Qiye knew that the game had changed. Whatever happened next, there was no going back to the way things were before.

Far away, on a mountain peak/spaceship/deck that no one had noticed until now, an old man/a woman/an AI watched the events unfold through a scrying orb/hologram/screen. "So it begins," he murmured. "The real test is yet to come."
